The Problem

  • Imitation learning needs diverse demonstration data
  • Current setup: Quest 3 teleoperation + RealSense recording
  • After 100+ demos, operators have no idea what's been collected
What goes wrong:
✗ Same grasp angle repeated over and over
✗ Certain approach directions never attempted
✗ Trained policy fails on unseen angles

Show operators what they've already collected

AR Visualization Design

Level 1 — Gripper Trajectory Replay

3D curves of past end-effector paths • color = success/fail • temporal gradient shows direction • gripper open/close icons at keyframes • button to filter trajectories

Level 2 — Approach Direction Heatmap

Spherical heatmap around the object • red = densely sampled • blue = under-sampled • instantly see which angles are missing

Level 3 — Real-Time Guidance

Arrow pointing to sparsest direction • redundancy alert if angle already covered • live comparison with most similar past trajectory
